testCases.label: Setup BankAccount instance before tests
testCases.description: Creates a BankAccount object with account number '1234567890' and initial balance 1000 before each test.

testCases.label: Verify initial account balance
testCases.description: Checks that a new BankAccount has the correct starting balance of 1000.

testCases.label: Verify deposit increases balance
testCases.description: Ensures that depositing 500 increases the account balance from 1000 to 1500.

testCases.label: Verify withdraw decreases balance
testCases.description: Ensures that withdrawing 200 decreases the account balance from 1000 to 800.

testCases.label: Verify account number retrieval
testCases.description: Checks that get_account_number() returns the correct account number '1234567890'.
